title: Link Access Check
summary: Before a message is sent, checks each cloud document link against its recipients, so nobody gets a link they can't open and nothing goes public by accident.
description: Pre-send check for Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Notion, Figma and Box links that names which recipients can't open each one, offers fixes (give view access, open to the company, ask the owner), and warns when an anyone-with-the-link doc goes outside your organisation.
catches: Recipients who can't open a linked document
Anyone-with-the-link documents going to people outside your domains
Links you can't re-share: suggests asking the owner
Links to the same document in different URL forms (?usp=sharing, /edit, /view) are treated as one
limits: Relies on your checkAccess function to ask each storage API; it can't see permissions itself
Only recognises the listed hosts plus extraHosts
Group memberships are only as accurate as your API's answer
a11y: Announcements go to a polite live region
Focus moves to the first fix, then to Send
Loading and retry states have text, with icons aria-hidden
server: Check sharing permissions with each provider's API on the server; never trust the client's view of who can open a document.
stops: Shared a link they can't open
mistakes: recipient can't open google drive link
